dedupe_keys.name: temporal validation of multiobjective sewage pumping rules

description: The package evaluates sewage-pumping rules for a station in Brasilia. Five-minute observations from 2022 define design windows, and policies are simulated over May-December 2023 to compare electricity, energy and overflow outcomes. This resource is provided by Formiga, Klebber. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Equipment and billing parameters are unverified. The provider explicitly says the rules were not operationally validated. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
